synopsis: MSC/Cadence Adams is a commercial, road-heritage, high-end multibody dynamics tool, rather than an environment or sensor simulator [f9146, f15974, f8597, f9148]. Its stated capabilities include rigid-body contact, flexible bodies and machine-mechanism modeling [f6392, f8596]. Chapter 8 includes Adams among commercial options for full multibody models supporting machine dynamics, actuator and failure analysis, and real-time co-simulation; this describes the modeling approach rather than demonstrating an Adams-specific validation workflow [f6454]. Although Chapter 11 includes Adams among vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil offerings, it reports no off-road evidence or off-road autonomy proof, leaving its suitability for this application unsubstantiated in the supplied facts [f8356, f9147, f8598]. No public price or latest release was found, and the interface listing identifies only the Cadence/MSC ecosystem [f9150, f9151, f9149].
